pages.title: Austral Islands
pages.extract: The Austral Islands of French Polynesia consist of the Tubuai Islands and the Bass Islands.

pages.title: Boonsboro
pages.description: town in Washington County, Maryland, United States
pages.extract: Boonsboro is a small town in Washington County, Western Maryland. Boonsboro is primarily an agricultural center, but it's also just a nice historic town for a leisurely lunch or dinner, and perhaps a stop at one of the museums, while exploring the area.

pages.title: Childersburg
pages.extract: Childersburg is a small town in Metropolitan Alabama near the Desoto Caverns and the Talladega Raceway.

pages.title: Frascati
pages.extract: Frascati is one of the Castelli Romani, historic hill towns southeast of Rome. It is a small relaxed town perfect for a getaway from the metropolis, world famous for its white wine which has won an array of awards. Frascati has a slower pace of life, cleaner air, and a far more casual feel than the nearby capital.

pages.title: Guadalupe (Arizona)
pages.description: town in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
pages.extract: Guadalupe  is a city in the Greater Phoenix region of Arizona.

pages.title: Magnetic Island
pages.description: island offshore the city of Townsville, Queensland, Australia
pages.extract: Magnetic Island (Wulguru: Yunbenun) is an island directly off the coast of Townsville in Central Queensland.  Over half the land area of the island is a National Park.  Magnetic Island is roughly 7 km by 5 km, with 25 km of walking tracks and several beaches and little bays. It is known as Maggie Island.

pages.title: Nowy Targ
pages.extract: Nowy Targ is a town in Małopolskie Province in southern Poland, 80 km south of Kraków. The main reason to visit is to explore the Gorce Mountains to the north, and Tatra Mountains to the south.

pages.extract: Puchong is a major town in Selangor, Malaysia.

pages.title: Puerto del Carmen
pages.description: human settlement in Tías, Las Palmas, Las Palmas Province, Canary Islands, Spain
pages.extract: Puerto del Carmen is a large tourist resort on the south coast of Lanzarote, a few km west of Arrecife the capital and airport. It has long sandy beaches (unusual on this island) which are more sheltered than the exposed north and west-facing coasts. It's part of the municipality of Tías but has far outgrown that small town, and in 2022 it had a population of 11,319.

pages.title: Vác
pages.extract: Vác is a town in the Danube Bend region. It is located on the eastern bank of the Danube near the magnificent Danube bend. Though not visited nearly as much as either Szentendre or Visegrád it can be a pleasant and enjoyable stopover between the two.

pages.title: Natural attractions
pages.extract:
Though mankind has impressed itself with cultural attractions and architecture, most of our feats have been dwarfed by the miracles of nature.

However, as our footprint on nature expands, many travellers want to take the opportunity to see these wonders before it is too late. Many argue that we should pursue sustainable travel and leave-no-trace camping to preserve them for future generations.
Geology is the study of the solid part of our planet. Amateur geology can include the study of natural formations, and the gathering of minerals.

pages.title: Illinois Driftless Area
pages.extract: The Illinois Driftless Area is a region in Northern Illinois containing the sole portions of the Driftless Zone in Illinois.  Like other portions of the Driftless Zone, the Illinois Driftless Area is noted for its high hills, deep river valleys and general scenic beauty.  Like many other regions in the area, its borders are somewhat fluid but generally contain all of Jo Daviees and Stephenson Counties as well as the western portions of Carroll County near the Mississippi River.

pages.title: Zagori
pages.description: historical and geographical region of Epirus, Greece
pages.extract: Zagori, also called Zagorochoria (The Zagori Villages) is a historical area and a municipality in Epirus, Greece, with an area of some 1,000 km², including 46 villages. Since 2023 the Zagori Cultural Landscape has been a  UNESCO World Heritage Site.

pages.title: Cupar
pages.description: town and former royal burgh in Fife, Scotland, UK
pages.extract: Cupar is a historic market town that is the largest settlement in Fife, in the north east of Scotland.

pages.title: Lesa
pages.extract: Lesa is a small but charming lakeside town on Lake Maggiore. It is situated between the more well-known towns of Arona in one direction and Stresa in the other.
